response.rationale: CK7/CK5/6/AE1-AE3 positivity with vimentin, absence of TTF1/NapsinA/P63/P40, plus S100/CD34 positivity and KEAP1 mutation, best support sarcomatoid carcinoma; carcinosarcoma lacks heterologous sarcoma evidence and desmin/SMA are negative.

rejected.why: Too nonspecific; the epithelial and sarcomatoid IHC profile with KEAP1 mutation supports the specific sarcomatoid carcinoma subtype instead.
Lymphoma would not produce the strong cytokeratin expression (AE1/AE3, CK7, CK5/6) or KEAP1 mutation, and no lymphoma markers are provided.
D2-40/WT1/calretinin are only focal or partial, EMA is negative, and KEAP1 mutation with hilar mass and bilateral lung nodules favors lung sarcomatoid carcinoma.
Too broad; R2 provides the supported specific histologic subtype.
No microbiologic or inflammatory evidence is present; imaging and IHC indicate a neoplastic epithelial/mesenchymal process.
Sarcoidosis lacks granulomatous histology and cannot account for CK-positive tumor cells or KEAP1 mutation.
Squamous cell carcinoma is contradicted by negative P63 and P40.
Adenocarcinoma is contradicted by negative TTF1 and NapsinA.
